# hipc (hippius-cli)

> The old Hippius command-line tool. It targeted the retired IPFS storage backend. Do not install it and do not use it against the current network.

Part of the Hippius docs for agents. Start at https://docs.hippius.com/llms.txt

## What it is and what it does

`hipc` was a Rust CLI for IPFS pinning, uploads, and node registration. The docs mark that CLI deprecated: the IPFS-based tool is no longer functional while a replacement for Arion is built.

https://docs.hippius.com/cli/usage

## How to install

Do not install it.

`brew tap thenervelab/tap && brew install hipc` is still written in the tap README. The formula points at release files that are not a working install. The commands (`hipc storage pin`, `hipc upload-to-ipfs`, and the rest of the IPFS-era surface) do not apply to current storage.

## What to use instead

| Job | Use |
|---|---|
| Store or fetch files | Any S3 client at https://s3.hippius.com. Agent file: https://github.com/thenervelab/hippius-s3/blob/staging/llms.txt |
| Models and containers | `pip install hippius_hub`. Agent file: https://github.com/thenervelab/hippius-hub/blob/main/llms.txt |
| Run a storage miner | The Arion miner guides, not this CLI and not the IPFS Ansible repo. https://docs.hippius.com/earn/arion/running-miner |
| Register a node on chain | The registration guide: https://docs.hippius.com/earn/register-in-blockchain |
